notes: Verified on the official stock 0.5.0.6 HTML (sha256 b14693f5...): bare loader and a 2-mod pack (ModLoaderGui + ModLoaderNeoUI) both boot to the Start passage with 2 mods loaded and no dialogs.
Official stock 0.5.0.6 uses an older unminified engine layout. The boot body is refactored in place; the rest of its engine is preserved.
The 26-mod pack is built against 0.5.12.13 and is not guaranteed to run on 0.5.0.6; install bare or with a small set of version-agnostic UI mods.
Import guards are optional and may be absent on this older build.
